packages.name: gi-plan-mode
packages.proof: Registers plan commands, enters read-only mode, renders progress, refines with dialogs/editor, and persists plan state.

packages.name: gi-subagents
packages.proof: Runs isolated child sessions, streams progress, reads bounded parent context, and cancels child work.

packages.name: gi-mcp-adapter
packages.proof: Supervises MCP servers, converts server tools to JSON Schema tools, streams progress, and reports diagnostics.

packages.name: gi-git-guard
packages.proof: Intercepts unsafe session actions, checks git state, asks for confirmation, and records decisions.

packages.name: gi-approval-gate
packages.proof: Intercepts sensitive tool calls, renders command/diff context, and returns approve, deny, or rewrite decisions.

packages.name: gi-powerline-footer
packages.proof: Renders model, branch, token, context, and tool-activity status through semantic theme tokens and mounts a footer ViewTree segment from the official command path.

packages.name: gi-todo-widget
packages.proof: Registers todo tools and renderers, persists todo state, rehydrates on session switch, and mounts current todos as a command-scoped ViewTree widget.

packages.name: gi-tools-ui
packages.proof: Displays tools, toggles active state, persists scope, and updates the canonical tool set.
